title: Population
description: Population by country, available from 10,000 BCE to 2100, based on data and estimates from different sources.

title: Annual CO₂ emissions from cement
description: Annual emissions of carbon dioxide (CO₂) from cement, measured in million tonnes.

title: Annual CO₂ emissions
description: Annual total emissions of carbon dioxide (CO₂), excluding land-use change, measured in million tonnes.

title: CO₂ emissions per capita
description: Carbon dioxide (CO₂) emissions from burning fossil fuels and industrial processes. This includes emissions from transport, electricity generation, and heating, but not land-use change.
source: Global Carbon Budget (2025) [https://globalcarbonbudget.org/]; Population based on various sources (2024) [https://ourworldindata.org/population-sources]

title: Annual CO₂ emissions from coal
description: Annual emissions of carbon dioxide (CO₂) from coal, measured in million tonnes.

title: Cumulative CO₂ emissions
description: Total cumulative emissions of carbon dioxide (CO₂), excluding land-use change, since the first year of available data, measured in million tonnes.

title: Annual CO₂ emissions from flaring
description: Annual emissions of carbon dioxide (CO₂) from flaring, measured in million tonnes.

title: Annual CO₂ emissions from gas
description: Annual emissions of carbon dioxide (CO₂) from gas, measured in million tonnes.

title: Annual CO₂ emissions from oil
description: Annual emissions of carbon dioxide (CO₂) from oil, measured in million tonnes.

title: Annual CO₂ emissions from other industry
description: Annual emissions of carbon dioxide (CO₂) from other industry sources, measured in million tonnes.

title: Share of global annual CO₂ emissions
description: Annual total emissions of carbon dioxide (CO₂), excluding land-use change, measured as a percentage of global emissions of CO₂ in the same year.

title: Share of global cumulative CO₂ emissions
description: Total cumulative emissions of carbon dioxide (CO₂), excluding land-use change, since the first year of available data, measured as a percentage of global total cumulative emissions of CO₂.
